source.name: SportEconomy: FIR e Vittoria Assicurazioni prolungano partnership fino al 2028
source.quote: Come sponsor di maglia accompagniamo gli Azzurri e le Azzurre nelle diverse competizioni internazionali che li vedono protagonisti in campo
source.note: Renewal of the main sponsorship of the FIR (national men's, women's and Under-20 teams) to 2028, announced with FIR at the launch of the Quilter Nations Series; 'sponsor di maglia' = shirt sponsor. The official Macron product photos of the 2026/27 home shirt (first worn for the November 2026 internationals) show the large white 'Vittoria Assicurazioni' wordmark centre front (also visible on rugbystuff.com).

source.name: FS News: A tifare la Nazionale Italiana di Rubgy con il Frecciarossa
source.quote: Frecciarossa conferma il suo impegno a fianco della Nazionale Italiana di Rugby come treno ufficiale degli azzurri
source.note: FS News is the Gruppo FS online title; the article confirms the ongoing partnership for the November 2025 internationals (the original FIR/Trenitalia announcement of 3 Feb 2023 said the Frecciarossa brand would debut 'sul retro delle maglie' — on the back of the shirts). The official 2026/27 home product photos show the FRECCIAROSSA wordmark and tricolore bar across the upper back.

source.name: Federazione Italiana Rugby: Macron e FIR presentano i nuovi kit Home e Away 26/27 per le Nazionali Azzurre
source.quote: i nuovi Home e Away Kit 2026/27 realizzati da Macron, partner tecnico della FIR, si ispirano al Futurismo
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers.

summary: Vittoria Assicurazioni (private insurer controlled by the Acutis family) on the front and Frecciarossa (Trenitalia's brand, owned by the Italian state via the Ministry of Economy and Finance) across the upper back; Macron makes the kit. The launch text and the official 2026/27 product photos (shirt front, back, sleeves, collar and hem, plus the home shorts) show no other commercial marks: plain sleeves, FIR crest and Macron Hero on the chest, an 'ITALIA' emboss on the back hem and an 'Official Licensed Product / Eco Fabric' label. Nothing found on any sponsor.
